ui.teamBridge.archive.menu.archive.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.menu.archive.note: Archives a channel. Sentence case; the noun "channel" names a Slack-style group chat.

ui.teamBridge.archive.section.menu.role: accessible name of an icon-only menu button
ui.teamBridge.archive.section.menu.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.section.menu.note: Names the "..." button on the Channels section header; screen-reader only.

ui.teamBridge.archive.section.archived.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.section.archived.note: Opens the list of archived channels. Also the heading of that list.

ui.teamBridge.archive.confirm.title.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.confirm.title.note: {name} is a channel name WITHOUT the leading #. The # before it is part of this message and must stay.

ui.teamBridge.archive.confirm.body.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.confirm.body.note: States consequences of archiving: read access stays, posting stops, reversible.

ui.teamBridge.archive.confirm.confirm.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.confirm.confirm.note: Confirms archiving. Same words as the menu item.

ui.teamBridge.archive.confirm.error.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.confirm.error.note: Archive request failed. One short sentence plus a retry hint.

ui.teamBridge.archive.banner.by_on.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.banner.by_on.note: {name} is the display name of the person who archived it; {date} is a localized date and time. Word order may change.

ui.teamBridge.archive.banner.on.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.banner.on.note: Used when the archiver is unknown. {date} is a localized date and time.

ui.teamBridge.archive.banner.plain.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.banner.plain.note: Used when neither archiver nor date is known.

ui.teamBridge.archive.banner.unarchive.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.banner.unarchive.note: Restores the channel to the sidebar so people can post again.

ui.teamBridge.archive.banner.delete.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.banner.delete.note: Opens the permanent-deletion confirmation. Must read as irreversible.

ui.teamBridge.archive.banner.unarchive_e.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.

ui.teamBridge.archive.composer.note.role: quiet note replacing the message box
ui.teamBridge.archive.composer.note.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.composer.note.note: Shown where the composer would be on an archived channel.

ui.teamBridge.archive.delete.title.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.delete.title.note: {name} is the channel name WITHOUT the leading #. The # is part of this message.

ui.teamBridge.archive.delete.body.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.delete.body.note: Must state that messages, threads, reactions AND attachments are erased and that this cannot be undone or recovered. Do not soften.

ui.teamBridge.archive.delete.confirm_lab.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.delete.confirm_lab.note: {name} is the exact channel name the person must type to enable deletion. Keep {name} verbatim.

ui.teamBridge.archive.delete.confirm.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.delete.confirm.note: Performs the permanent deletion. Same words as the banner button.

ui.teamBridge.archive.delete.error.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.

ui.teamBridge.archive.list.empty.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.list.empty.note: No archived channels exist for this reader.

ui.teamBridge.archive.list.loading.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.

ui.teamBridge.archive.list.error.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.list.error.note: The archived list could not be read. A Try again button follows.

ui.teamBridge.archive.list.meta_by_on.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.

ui.teamBridge.archive.list.meta_on.length: Short; fit the dialog or one rail line.
ui.teamBridge.archive.list.meta_on.note: Used when the archiver is unknown.

ui.teamBridge.archive.thread.empty.role: empty-state line in a message pane
ui.teamBridge.archive.thread.empty.note: Shown INSTEAD of the 'say hello' prompt when an archived channel has no messages: nobody can post, so do not invite anyone to. A plain fact, no apology.

ui.teamBridge.archive.thread.forbidden.role: empty-state explanation in a message pane
ui.teamBridge.archive.thread.forbidden.note: Shown to an organization owner/admin who opened an archived channel they never joined. They may archive, unarchive and delete it but the server does not give them its messages. Not an error and not something to retry.

ui.teamBridge.archive.delete.not_found.role: inline error under a destructive dialog
ui.teamBridge.archive.delete.not_found.note: The server answers one identical 'not found' to two situations: the channel is already deleted, or the person may no longer delete it. This sentence must NOT claim either: do not say 'deleted' as a fact, do not say 'refused'. Suggest refreshing the list to see which.

ui.teamBridge.archive.list.load_more.note: Fetches the next page of archived channels.

ui.teamBridge.archive.list.load_more_err.note: Shown when fetching the next page of archived channels failed; the button stays for a retry.

ui.teamBridge.archive.toast.archive_fail.note: {name} is the channel's name; keep {name} verbatim. The channel was removed from the sidebar optimistically and has been put back because the server refused the archive. Say both: it failed, and it is still there.
